purpose: ADR-142 (11.10.2026): a municipal regulation provision named in the question, in the ways a person writes it (the title in the genitive with the municipality, in quotation marks after the council, as it stands, without the paragraph mark), sections near the start of an act and far into it; one question that names another municipality than the one searched (nothing may be fetched by place), and a law as the control (ADR-135). region: the municipality the search is made in. No deciding phrases: the measure is whether the named provision is in the evidence (the diagnosis script named in the ADR). The saved query vectors are on the server (rag-v2-work/eval-files/regulation-provision-1/vectors.json).
